Kungani Isikrini Sami Sasekhaya Sibukeka Ngokuhlukile?

Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlelo Zokusebenza Okwenziwe Lula:\nSwayiphela phezulu kusuka phansi esikrinini ukuze ubone ngokushesha zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza ozifakile. Lesi senzo esinembile sikuvumela ukuba uhlele, uqalise, noma ususe izinhlelo zokusebenza kalula, kusiza ukugcina idivayisi yakho ingenazo izinto ezingadingekile futhi isebenza ngempumelelo.
Swayiphela phezulu kusuka phansi esikrinini, cindezela isithonjana sohlelo lokusebenza isikhathi eside, bese uchofoza Ulwazi lohlelo lokusebenza ukuze ulukhiphe.

Isiqalisi (launcher) siyisixhumi esibonakalayo somsebenzisi esiphatha isikrini sasekhaya nekhabethe lezinhlelo zokusebenza kudivayisi yakho yeselula. Ngokushintshela kwisiqalisi esihlukile, uthola ikhono lokwenza ngokwezifiso ukubukeka okuphelele kokubonakalayo nokusebenza okuyisisekelo kwesikrini sasekhaya sedivayisi yakho.

Isikrini sasekhaya sesiqalisi ngasinye sihlukile. Ngemva kokufaka i-Amz Wallpaper Launcher, isikrini sakho sasekhaya siyashintshwa ukuze sinikeze ukufinyelela okusheshayo Kumenyu Yamathuluzi ngokuswayiphela kwesokudla. Uma ufuna izinhlelo zakho zokusebenza ezifakiwe, ungazithola kalula ngokuswayiphela phezulu.

Indlela Yokubuyisela Isikrini Sakho Sasekhaya Sangaphambili:
Uma unganelisekile ngesakhiwo sakho samanje sesikrini sasekhaya, unenketho yokusibuyisela kwesangaphambili. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi uma ukhetha ukungasebenzisi i-Amz Wallpaper Launcher njengesikrini sakho sasekhaya esizenzakalelayo, ngeke usakwazi ukufinyelela isici esikahle Semenyu Yamathuluzi ngaphakathi kwalolu hlelo lokusebenza. Chofoza inkinobho engezansi ukuze ulungise isethingi sesiqalisi sakho esizenzakalelayo.
